changes.result: Location-scoped reports omit capability/value-stream links from the network-wide view because those links have no location lineage. Network-wide reports retain the view.
Anti-capture policy counts are restricted to published policies assigned to the requested location.

Each per-location report section runs under a PostgreSQL savepoint. Failed statements roll back to the section boundary so later sections can continue; an inner helper that swallows a database exception is detected when releasing the savepoint.
The report source, query-scope, helper-scope, and runtime SQL inventories were regenerated from the changed source.
